Detailed Steps: 1. Open the application in your browser. 2. Find and click the link that says "Register" or "Sign up" or "Create account" (usually near the Login button). 3. You should now see the Registration page with several fields. 4. Fill in every field that has a star or is marked required: email address, password, company name, and any other required fields shown. 5. Re-enter the password in the confirmation field if present. 6. Click the "Submit" or "Create account" or "Register" button at the bottom. 7. Wait a few seconds.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The page should show a success message (e.g. "Account created successfully"). 2. You should be automatically taken to the Login page (you will see the login form with email and password fields). 3. Check the email inbox you used for registration: you should receive a welcome email from the application. If any of these do not happen, note it in Spotted Problems.

Test Case: Registration with Store info (decline company info)
Detailed Steps: 1. Go to the Registration page (same as above). 2. Fill in all required fields for the first screen. 3. When the form asks whether to use company information for the store, select "No" or leave the option unchecked. 4. You should now see additional fields for Store (e.g. store name, address). Fill those in. 5. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A success message appears. 2. You are redirected to the Login page. 3. A welcome email is sent to your email address. 4. When you later log in and go to Company or Stores, the store you entered should appear separately from the company info.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to the Registration page. 2. Enter an email address that is already registered in the system (use an account you created in a previous test). 3. Fill all other required fields with valid data. 4. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should NOT succeed. 2. You should see an error message on the page, for example "Email already registered" or "This email is already in use". 3. You should remain on the registration page so you can change the email. 4. No welcome email should be sent for this attempt.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to the Registration page. 2. Enter a phone number that is already used by another account. 3. Fill all other required fields. 4. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Registration should fail. 2. A clear error message should appear (e.g. "Phone number already in use"). 3. You stay on the registration form.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to the Registration page. 2. Enter a TIN (Tax Identification Number) that is already used by another account. 3. Fill all other required fields. 4. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Registration should fail. 2. An error message should appear (e.g. "TIN already registered"). 3. You remain on the registration form.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to the Registration page. 2. In the email field type something that is not a valid email, e.g. "notanemail" or "test" (no @ sign). 3. Fill all other required fields correctly. 4. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should not submit. 2. You should see a validation message under or near the email field, e.g. "Please enter a valid email address". 3. You stay on the registration page.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to the Registration page. 2. In the password field enter a short word (e.g. "123" or "ab"). 3. Fill all other required fields. 4. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should not submit. 2. A message should appear saying the password is too short or does not meet requirements (e.g. minimum 8 characters). 3. You remain on the registration form.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to the Registration page. 2. Leave at least one required field empty (e.g. leave email blank, or company name blank). 3. Fill the rest if needed. 4. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should not complete. 2. You should see validation messages (e.g. "This field is required") next to the empty required fields. 3. You stay on the registration page until you fill those fields.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open the Login page (link or URL that says login). 2. Type the exact email address you used when you registered. 3. Type the exact password you used when you registered. 4. Click the "Login" or "Sign in" button. 5. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The page should redirect you away from the login form. 2. You should land on a page that asks for OTP (one-time password). 3. Check your email: you should receive an email with a code. 4. The screen should allow you to enter that code to complete login. If you do not see the OTP step or email, note it in Spotted Problems.

Detailed Steps: 1. Use login credentials for a user who has an account but has never subscribed to a membership plan. 2. On the Login page enter that user's email and password. 3. Click Login. 4. Complete OTP if shown.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. After login you should be taken to the Membership page (you will see plans or a message to choose a plan). 2. You should NOT see the main dashboard or sidebar with Inventory, Orders, etc. until a plan is selected. 3. The page should clearly indicate that you need to select a membership plan.

Detailed Steps: 1. Use login credentials for a user who has an active membership subscription. 2. On the Login page enter that user's email and password. 3. Click Login. 4. Complete OTP if the application asks for it.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. You should be redirected to the main portal (dashboard). 2. You should see a sidebar or menu on the left with options such as Dashboard, Inventory, Orders, Finance, Profile, Company. 3. The bottom of the sidebar should show the logged-in company name. 4. The main area should show dashboard content (e.g. overview or welcome).

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to the Login page. 2. Do not type anything in the email or password fields (leave both blank). 3. Click the Login button.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should not submit successfully. 2. You should see validation message(s) such as "Email is required" or "Please fill in required fields". 3. You remain on the login page.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Login page in the email field type: notanemail (no @ or dot). 2. In the password field type any text (e.g. password123). 3. Click Login.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should not proceed. 2. A validation message should appear, e.g. "Please enter a valid email address". 3. You stay on the login page.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Login page enter a valid email format (e.g. test@example.com). 2. In the password field enter only a few characters (e.g. "12"). 3. Click Login.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should not proceed. 2. A message should appear indicating the password is too short or invalid. 3. You remain on the login page.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Login page enter an email that is registered in the system. 2. Enter a password that is NOT the correct password for that account. 3. Click Login. 4. Complete OTP if the app still asks.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Login should fail. 2. You should see an error message such as "Invalid credentials" or "Wrong password" or "Login failed". 3. You remain on the login page or return to it. 4. You should NOT see the dashboard or portal.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Login page enter an email that has never been registered (e.g. nonexistent@example.com). 2. Enter any password. 3. Click Login.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Login should fail. 2. An error message should appear (e.g. "User not found" or "Invalid credentials"). 3. You stay on the login page.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to the Login page. 2. Click the link that says "Forgot password" or "Reset password" (usually below the login button). 3. On the next screen enter the email address of an account that exists in the system. 4. Click Submit or Send. 5. Check that email inbox for an email containing an OTP or reset link. 6. Enter the OTP (or follow the link) and type a new password twice (new password and confirm). 7. Click Submit or Reset password.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. After step 4 you should see a message that an email was sent (or check your inbox). 2. After step 7 you should see a success message (e.g. "Password reset successfully"). 3. You should be able to go back to Login and log in using the NEW password. 4. Logging in with the OLD password should fail.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to the Login page and click Forgot password. 2. Enter an email address that is NOT registered in the system. 3. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. You should see an error message such as "Email not found" or "No account with this email". 2. No OTP or reset email should be sent to that address. 3. You remain on the forgot password or login page.

Detailed Steps: 1. Start the Forgot password flow and enter a valid registered email. 2. When asked for the OTP, type a wrong code (e.g. 000000 or random digits). 3. Enter a new password and confirm. 4. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The system should show an error (e.g. "Invalid OTP" or "Code expired"). 2. The password should NOT be changed. 3. You should be able to request a new OTP and try again with the correct code.

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in with a user that has active membership (use correct email and password and complete OTP if required). 2. Wait for the page to load after login. 3. Look at the screen.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. You should land on the Dashboard (the URL often contains "/portal" or "/dashboard"). 2. The left sidebar should show menu items (e.g. Dashboard, Inventory, Orders, Finance, Profile, Company). 3. At the bottom of the sidebar you should see the name of the company you are logged in as. 4. The main content area should show dashboard information (charts, summary, or welcome text).

Detailed Steps: 1. After logging in, look at the left sidebar. 2. Click on "Company". 3. You should see company details. Click the "Edit" or "Edit company" button. 4. A form or pop-up should open. Change one or more fields (e.g. company name or address). 5. Click "Save" or "Submit".
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A success message should appear (e.g. "Company updated successfully"). 2. The company details on the page should now show the new values you entered. 3. If you refresh the page or come back to Company later, the updated information should still be there.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Company and click Edit company. 2. Change one or more fields in the form. 3. Instead of Save, click "Cancel" or the X to close the form.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form or pop-up should close. 2. The company details on the page should still show the OLD values (no changes saved). 3. No success message should appear.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Company and click Edit company. 2. Clear a required field (e.g. delete the company name so it is empty). 3. Click Save or Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should not save. 2. You should see a validation message (e.g. "This field is required") near the empty field. 3. The form should stay open so you can fix it.

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in and click "Company" in the sidebar. 2. Click the "Employees" tab (or the section that shows the list of employees). 3. Click the "Add New Employee" or "Add Employee" button. 4. A form will open. Fill in all required fields (e.g. name, email, role). 5. Click Submit or Save.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A success message should appear (e.g. "Employee created successfully"). 2. The list of employees should refresh and the new employee should appear in the list. 3. You should see the new employee's name and details as entered.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Company > Employees and click Add New Employee. 2. Enter an email address that is already used by another employee or user in the system. 3. Fill other required fields. 4. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The system should show an error message (e.g. "Email already in use"). 2. The employee should NOT be created. 3. You remain on the form so you can change the email.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Company > Employees and click Add New Employee. 2. Leave one or more required fields empty (e.g. leave email or name blank). 3. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should not submit. 2. Validation messages should appear next to the empty required fields. 3. No new employee should be added to the list.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Company > Employees. 2. In the list find an employee and click "View details" or the view/view icon. 3. On the details page click "Edit" or the edit icon. 4. Change one or more fields (e.g. name or phone). 5. Click Save or Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A success message should appear. 2. The employee details should now show the updated information. 3. When you go back to the employee list, the updated data should be visible.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Company > Employees. 2. Find an employee in the list. 3. Click Delete (or the delete icon). 4. A confirmation message will appear (e.g. "Are you sure?"). Click "Confirm" or "Yes".
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The employee should be removed from the list. 2. You should see a success message. 3. When you view the list again, that employee should no longer appear. 4. You may be taken back to the employee list automatically.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Company > Employees and click Delete on an employee. 2. When the confirmation pop-up appears, click "Cancel" or "No".
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The pop-up should close. 2. The employee should still be in the list. 3. No deletion should occur.

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in and go to Company. 2. Click the "Stores" tab. 3. Click "Add store" or "Add Store". 4. Fill in the store details (e.g. store name, address) in the form. 5. Click Submit or Save.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A success message should appear. 2. The new store should appear in the stores list. 3. You should see the store name and details you entered.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Company > Stores and click Add store. 2. Leave required fields empty (e.g. store name). 3. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should not submit. 2. Validation errors should appear (e.g. "Store name is required"). 3. No new store should be created.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Company > Stores. 2. In the list click "View" or the view icon on a store. 3. On the store details page click "Edit". 4. Change one or more fields. 5. Click Save.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A success message should appear. 2. The store details should show the updated information. 3. The list should reflect the changes.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Company > Stores and open a store (View details). 2. Click the Delete button or delete icon. 3. When asked to confirm, click Confirm or Yes.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The store should be removed from the list. 2. A success message should appear. 3. The store should no longer appear when you view the stores list.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to the store or company area where customers are managed. 2. Open the "Customer" tab. 3. Click "Add new customer" or "Add customer". 4. Fill in the customer form (name, contact, etc.). 5. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A success message should appear. 2. The new customer should appear in the customers list. 3. The list should show the customer details you entered.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open Add new customer form. 2. Leave required fields empty. 3. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Validation messages should appear. 2. No customer should be created until required fields are filled.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to the area where suppliers are managed (e.g. Company or Store detail). 2. Open the "Supplier" tab. 3. Click "Add New Supplier" or "Add Supplier". 4. Fill in the supplier form. 5. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A success message should appear. 2. The new supplier should appear in the suppliers list. 3. The list should show the updated supplier list.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open Add New Supplier form. 2. Leave required fields empty. 3. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Validation errors should appear. 2. No supplier should be created.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to the Company or Identity/People area. 2. Look for an "Export" button (may be at the top of the list or in a menu). 3. Click Export. 4. If asked, select a format (e.g. CSV or Excel).
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A file should download to your computer (or a report should be generated). 2. When you open the file, it should contain the identity/company data (e.g. employees, stores) in the selected format.

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in and click "Profile" in the sidebar. 2. Find the section that shows your profile picture or avatar. 3. Click "Upload Photo" or "Change photo" or the camera/upload icon. 4. Select an image file from your computer (e.g. .jpg or .png). 5. Confirm or Save.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The image should upload. 2. Your new photo should be displayed in the profile area. 3. You may see a success message.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Profile and click Upload Photo. 2. Try to select a file that is not an image (e.g. a PDF or Word document). 3. Confirm or try to save.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The system should either reject the file or show an error (e.g. "Please upload an image file"). 2. The profile picture should not change to the invalid file.

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in and click "Profile" in the sidebar. 2. Click the "Password" tab (or the section for changing password). 3. Enter your current password in the "Current password" field. 4. Enter your new password in the "New password" field. 5. Enter the same new password again in "Confirm password". 6. Click Submit or Change password.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A success message should appear (e.g. "Password changed successfully"). 2. You should be able to log out and log back in using the NEW password. 3. The old password should no longer work.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Profile > Password tab. 2. Enter an incorrect current password. 3. Enter a new password and confirm it. 4. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The system should show an error (e.g. "Current password is incorrect"). 2. The password should NOT be changed. 3. You remain on the form.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Profile > Password tab. 2. Enter the correct current password. 3. Enter a new password in "New password". 4. Enter a different value in "Confirm password" (so they do not match). 5. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A validation error should appear (e.g. "Passwords do not match"). 2. The password should NOT be changed.

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in and click "Profile" in the sidebar. 2. Make sure you are on the "Profile" tab (not Password). 3. Click the "Edit" button. 4. A form will open. Change one or more fields (e.g. first name, last name, phone). 5. Click Save or Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A success message should appear. 2. The profile page should now display the updated information. 3. The changes should persist if you leave and come back to Profile.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Profile and click Edit. 2. Change some fields in the form. 3. Click Cancel or the X to close the form without saving.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should close. 2. The profile should still show the old data (no changes saved).
